name: private-function-history
goal: Explicit removal-commit addresses retain private functions last active contracts without adding them to shared collections

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: At an explicit removal commit, the retained private function address must show its last active parent contract and Removed at this commit. Private functions remain excluded from shared catalogs. The hosted lifecycle scenario currently renders Not at this revision.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing unit coverage tests public removals and active private ownership separately. Extend the existing entity-frame render suite across retired tombstones and fully absent head entries, asserting parent contract, removed verdict, catalog exclusion, missing-parent and unrelated-revision guards. The unchanged hosted catalog private lifecycle scenario independently reproduces the same failure.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Unchanged standardized entity-frame cases fail at committed test revision 9aa2ea3f for the exact assertion removed private functions retain the parent contract. Immutable Harness red checkpoint 08ab935aa0091a22081080f1ea79a40f286325056ac25f26e44d20c21f59874e, exit 1, fixed environment cb01adcd. No product repair exists in that snapshot.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: EntityFrame uses an explicit-address resolver that first reads active head units, then allows the parent contract only for an id explicitly removed by head. The same removed projection retains its verdict and lastAt. Private collections retain their default exclusion. Source fix 2eb9c49b.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged four entity-frame tests pass at separate fix commit 2eb9c49b using the identical command, fixture hash and fixed cb01adcd environment. Green checkpoint is retained in Harness immutable regression history; both retired-tombstone and fully-absent lifecycle variants now preserve originalInput and reject unrelated revisions or missing parents.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
